object: Wall label: column of inscription before figure A (a man in elaborate costume) in the sculptured Meroitic Chamber
site: Philae, Great Temple of Isis, Meroitic Chamber
notes: Published L., D., VI, Bl. 4, no. 13; photo Berlin Academy. Griffith translates 'The honoured(?) strategus of the water, sate of Bekemete, Manitawawi; yetetake of the wete in Shiye(?) and chief wemañas in Philae, prophet of the king(?), royal consort(?) of (the king's) mother(?), khabkhañ and chief shaqate, malêshatêkhe'; the same man is labelled in 105. His '?' stands over the first sign of Siyeteli. Words are spaced as printed (word gaps measured): qorito is one word (the 2026-11-09 test split it), qo(15)re and yetet(10)ke are single words cut by the line number. Re-read from the type for the codes; the test's m in womñt- is ẖ, as the test itself found. FHN III no. 267 differs at womnetẖ, sqotelẖlo and mlostoselo (Griffith renders shaqate and malêshatêkhe, backing the type).
